text: AI code review tools cut production defects by 40 % and are now used by most engineering teams. A 2025 trial confirmed the effect on defects.
sources:
[S1 Lee 2025, randomised trial, n=120] No statistically significant difference in defects per KLOC; review time down 28 %.
[S2 Smith 2024, survey, n=400] 62 % of teams report using an AI review tool.
[S3 Vendor whitepaper 2025] Customers see 40 % fewer production incidents.
